@@U03961@@
But, look, this wisp of cloud, delicate, shining, lingering still to cool and cheer my heart and brow— gently caressing. It rises now, lightly, higher, higher still, massing itself together. What! Am I deceived? Seeing things? This rapturous image so like my youth’s first, long-lost, highest good? A wave of emotions from my earliest days sweeps through me. Aurora’s love, love's early dawn, the soaring joy, soon felt, scarce understood, which, if held fast to, would outshine the most precious things of all! Now, like the soul’s beauty, that gracious form grows ever more perfect, holds, then rising into the higher regions takes with itself the best of me. (A seven-league boot comes clomping in, immediately followed by the second. 梅菲斯特 steps out of them. The boots hurry off.)

@@U03963@@
Yes, well, that’s what I call making tracks! But tell me now, what can you have been thinking? I mean, to dismount in the midst of this horror, these grizzly, yawning, gruesome crags! Oh, I know them, all right, just not exactly quite here. Fact is, this was once the bottom of Hell.
translation:
@@U03961@@
但是，你看，这一缕云，娇柔的，闪亮的，依然萦绕在我的心眉间，让我清凉、愉悦——轻轻地抚摸着。现在它轻轻地升起，更高，更高，聚集在一起。什么！我被骗了吗？看东西？这种欣喜若狂的景象，就像我年轻时的第一个、久违的、至高无上的善吗？早年的一股情绪席卷了我。奥罗拉的爱，爱的黎明，飞扬的喜悦，很快就感受到了，很难理解，如果紧紧抓住，它将超越所有最珍贵的东西！现在，就像灵魂的美丽一样，那种优雅的形式变得越来越完美，然后升入更高的领域，带走我最好的东西。 （一只七级联赛的靴子踩了进来，紧接着是第二只。梅菲斯特从其中走出来。靴子赶紧脱掉。）

@@U03963@@
是的，好吧，这就是我所说的制作曲目！但现在告诉我，你一直在想什么？我的意思是，在这恐怖之中下马，这些灰白的、打哈欠的、可怕的峭壁！哦，我认识他们，好吧，只是不完全在这里。事实上，这里曾经是地狱的底部。
